description: Animate a forward pass through a 3-layer neural network [4, 6, 3] using make_forward_pass_animation to show data flowing through layers.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_ml.neural_network import NeuralNetwork, FeedForwardLayer

class FFNForwardPass(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        nn = NeuralNetwork([
            FeedForwardLayer(4),
            FeedForwardLayer(6),
            FeedForwardLayer(3),
        ], layer_spacing=0.25)
        nn.move_to(ORIGIN)
        self.add(nn)
        self.play(nn.make_forward_pass_animation())
        self.wait(0.5)
